582.g: ਬਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ; ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ. ਤਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
582.e: The True Lord sits and writes of ambrosial nectar, and bitter poison; as the Lord attaches us, so are we attached.

582.g: ਕਾਮਣਿਆਰੀ ਕਾਮਣ ਪਾਏ; ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਗਲਿ ਤਾਗਾ ॥
582.e: The Charmer, Maya, has worked her charms, and the multi-colored thread is around everyone's neck.

582.g: ਹੋਛੀ ਮਤਿ. ਭਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਛਾ; ਗੁੜੁ ਸਾ. ਮਖੀ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
582.e: Through shallow intellect, the mind becomes shallow, and one eats the fly, along with the sweets.

582.g: ਨਾ ਮਰਜਾਦੁ. ਆਇਆ ਕਲਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਨਾਂਗੋ ਬੰਧਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
582.e: Contrary to custom, he comes into the Dark Age of Kali Yuga naked, and naked he is bound down and sent away again. ||3||

582.g: ਬਾਬਾ. ਰੋਵਹੁ ਜੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਰੋਵਣਾ; ਜਾਨੀਅੜਾ ਬੰਧਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਹੈ ॥
582.e: O Baba, weep and mourn if you must; the beloved soul is bound and driven off.

582.g: ਲਿਖਿਅੜਾ ਲੇਖੁ. ਨ ਮੇਟੀਐ; ਦਰਿ. ਹਾਕਾਰੜਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੈ ॥
582.e: The pre-ordained record of destiny cannot be erased; the summons has come from the Lord's Court.

582.g: ਹਾਕਾਰਾ ਆਇਆ. ਜਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਇਆ; ਰੁੰਨੇ ਰੋਵਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
582.e: The messenger comes, when it pleases the Lord, and the mourners begin to mourn.

582.g: ਪੁਤ ਭਾਈ ਭਾਤੀਜੇ ਰੋਵਹਿ; ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
582.e: Sons, brothers, nephews and very dear friends weep and wail.

582.g: ਭੈ ਰੋਵੈ. ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ; ਕੋ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਮੁਇਆ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
582.e: Let him weep, who weeps in the Fear of God, cherishing the virtues of God. No one dies with the dead.

582.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਜਾਣ ਸਿਜਾਣਾ; ਰੋਵਹਿ. ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੫॥
582.e: O Nanak, throughout the ages, they are known as wise, who weep, remembering the True Lord. ||4||5||
TARAK STANZA
Now Kalki will get enraged and will knock down and kill a gathering of warriors, he will strike blows with various types of weapons and will destroy the groups of enemies.307.

The arrows contacting the armours will be discharged and in this war, the gods and demons will all confront one another, there will be showers of lances and arrows and the warriors will strike shouting “kill, kill” from their months.308.

He will take out his axe and sword and in his fury, he will strike the gods and demons, he will cause the corpses fall over corpses in the war-arena and seeing this, the fiends and fairies will get pleased.309.
The ganas of Shiva will roar and seeing them in affliction, all the people will run away, they will move in the war-arena discharging the arrows continuously.310.
The swords will collide with one another and seeing all this, the great warriors will thunder, the generals will march forward from both the sides and shout “kill, kill” from their mouths.311.
Ganas, Gandharvas and gods will see all this and will raise the sounds of “hail, hail”, the axes and swords will be struck and the limbs, being cut into halves, will fall,312.

The intoxicated horses imbued with war, will neigh and the sound of anklets and small cymbals will be heard, the generals of both the sides will fall upon each other and will glisten their swords, while holding them in their hands.313.

The groups of elephants will roar in the war-arena and seeing them, the clouds will feel shy, all will fight in anger and the canopies of chariots etc. will drop from the hands of the warriors very quickly.314.

The war-trumpets sounded in all the directions and the warriors raising shouts turned towards the war-arena, now in their fury, they will strike blows with their swords and will quickly inflict wounds on the warriors.315.

Taking out his sword in his hand and glistening it, Kalki will increase his approbation in the Iron Age, he will scatter the corpse upon corpse and aiming the warriors as targets, he will kill them.316.

The thick clouds will rush forth in the war-arena and in the winking of the eye, the arrows will be discharged, he will hold his swords and strike it with a jerk and the crackling noise of the arrows will be heard.317.
Someone is coming running and is not retracing even two steps backwards, they are striking blows like playing Holi.306.

583.e: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

583.g: ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ; ਪਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
583.e: Listen, O brides of the Lord: serve your Beloved Husband Lord, and contemplate the Word of His Shabad.

583.g: ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ. ਪਿਰੁ, ਨ ਜਾਣਈ; ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
583.e: The worthless bride does not know her Husband Lord - she is deluded; forgetting her Husband Lord, she weeps and wails.

583.g: ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤ ਸੰਮਾਲਿ. ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਰਿ; ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਰੈ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
583.e: She weeps, thinking of her Husband Lord, and she cherishes His virtues; her Husband Lord does not die, and does not leave.

583.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ. ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤਾ; ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
583.e: As Gurmukh, she knows the Lord; through the Word of His Shabad, He is realized; through True Love, she merges with Him.

583.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਅਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ. ਨਹੀ ਜਾਤਾ, ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ; ਕੂੜਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਕੂੜਿਆਰੇ ॥
583.e: She who does not know her Husband Lord, the Architect of karma, is deluded by falsehood - she herself is false.

583.g: ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਕੰਤ ਮਹੇਲੀਹੋ; ਪਿਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
583.e: Listen, O brides of the Lord: serve your Beloved Husband Lord, and contemplate the Word of His Shabad. ||1||

583.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ; ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
583.e: He Himself created the whole world; the world comes and goes.

583.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਖੁਆਇਅਨੁ; ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ ॥
583.e: The love of Maya has ruined the world; people die, to be re-born, over and over again.

583.g: ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰਾ. ਵਧਹਿ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ; ਗਿਆਨ ਵਿਹੂਣੀ ਮੂਠੀ ॥
583.e: People die to be re-born, over and over again, while their sins increase; without spiritual wisdom, they are deluded.

583.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਪਿਰੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਓ, ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ; ਰੋਵੈ ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੀ ਝੂਠੀ ॥
583.e: Without the Word of the Shabad, the Husband Lord is not found; the worthless, false bride wastes her life away, weeping and wailing.

583.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ. ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਰੋਈਐ; ਰੋਵੈ ਕੰਤੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
583.e: He is my Beloved Husband Lord, the Life of the World - for whom should I weep? They alone weep, who forget their Husband Lord.

583.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇਓਨੁ; ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
583.e: He Himself created the whole world; the world comes and goes. ||2||

583.g: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚਾ. ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ; ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥
583.e: That Husband Lord is True, forever True; He does not die, and He does not leave.

583.g: ਭੂਲੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਧਨ ਇਆਣੀਆ; ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ ॥
583.e: The ignorant soul-bride wanders in delusion; in the love of duality, she sits like a widow.

583.g: ਰੰਡ ਬੈਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਏ. ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ; ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
583.e: She sits like a widow, in the love of duality; through emotional attachment to Maya, she suffers in pain. She is growing old, and her body is withering away.

583.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਸੀ; ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ॥
583.e: Whatever has come, all that shall pass away; through the love of duality, they suffer in pain.

583.g: ਜਮਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਸੂਝੈ, ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗੁ ਲੂਝੈ; ਲਬਿ ਲੋਭਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥
583.e: They do not see the Messenger of Death; they long for Maya, and their consciousness is attached to greed.

583.g: ਸੋ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ. ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਚਾ; ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ. ਨ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
583.e: That Husband Lord is True, forever True; He does not die, and He does not leave. ||3||

583.g: ਇਕਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ. ਪਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ; ਅੰਧੀ. ਨਾ ਜਾਣੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
583.e: Some weep and wail, separated from their Husband Lord; the blind ones do not know that their Husband is with them.

583.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
583.e: By Guru's Grace, they may meet with their True Husband, and cherish Him always deep within.

583.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੇ. ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਰੇ ॥
583.e: She cherishes her Husband deep within herself - He is always with her; the self-willed manmukhs think that He is far away.

583.g: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਰੁਲੈ ਰੁਲਾਇਆ, ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਆ; ਜਿਨਿ ਖਸਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਤਾ ਹਦੂਰੇ ॥
583.e: This body rolls in the dust, and is totally useless; it does not realize the Presence of the Lord and Master.

583.g: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ; ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
583.e: Renouncing ego, I serve them; thus I meet my True Husband Lord, with intuitive ease.

583.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਆਏ. ਸਾਚੁ ਕਮਾਏ; ਸਾਚਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਨ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
583.e: The True Husband Lord comes to meet the soul-bride who practices Truth, and is imbued with the True Word of the Shabad.

583.g: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਰਾਂਡ. ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ; ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧੀ ॥
583.e: She shall never become a widow; she shall always be a happy bride. Deep within herself, she dwells in the celestial bliss of Samaadhi.

583.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਭਰਪੂਰੇ. ਵੇਖੁ ਹਦੂਰੇ; ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
583.e: Her Husband Lord is fully pervading everywhere; beholding Him ever-present, she enjoys His Love, with intuitive ease.

583.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਪੂਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਜਾਏ ॥੩॥
583.e: Those who have realized their Husband Lord - I go and ask those Saints about Him. ||3||

583.g: ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਹ; ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਹ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥
583.e: The separated ones also meet with their Husband Lord, if they fall at the Feet of the True Guru.

583.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ; ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ ॥
583.e: The True Guru is forever merciful; through the Word of His Shabad, demerits are burnt away.

583.g: ਅਉਗੁਣ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਏ. ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਗਵਾਏ; ਸਚੇ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
583.e: Burning away her demerits through the Shabad, the soul-bride eradicates her love of duality, and remains absorbed in the True, True Lord.

583.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਭਰਾਤੀ ॥
583.e: Through the True Shabad, everlasting peace is obtained, and egotism and doubt are dispelled.

583.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਾਇਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
583.e: The Immaculate Husband Lord is forever the Giver of peace; O Nanak, through the Word of His Shabad, He is met.

583.g: ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ ਭੀ ਮਿਲਹ; ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਹ ਸਾਚੇ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
583.e: The separated ones also meet with their Husband Lord, if they fall at the feet of the True Guru. ||4||1||

The elephants, horses, chariots and chariot-riders will be chopped and the warriors catching each other by their hair, they ill swing, there will be blows of legs and fists and the heads will be shattered with teeth.318.

The kings of the earth will re-array their armies and hold their bows and arrows, there will be fought a dreadful war in anger in both the directions and the warriors will obtain a place in heaven in the dreadful war.319.
The swords will clatter and the jingling of the steel armours will be heard, the sharp-edged weapons will produce knocking sounds and the Holi of the war will be played.320.
The lances will be struck from both sides and the matted locks of the warriors will roll in dust, the spears will collide while striking blows like the thundering of the clouds of Sawan.321.

The warriors grinding their teeth in anger will cause their horses to dance from both sides, they will discharged arrows from their bows in the war-arena and will cut the saddles of horses and the armours.322.

583.g: ਘਟਿ ਜਿਉ ਘਣਿ ਕੀ ਘੁਰਿ ਢੂਕਹਿਗੇ ॥

583.e: The warriors will rush forth like clouds and will roam in all the ten directions, shouting,”kill, kill”, with their utterance of “kill, kill”, the heart of Sumeru mountain will all move.323.
Crores of elephants and horses and also the riders of elephants will die fighting. To what extent the poet will describe them? The ganas, gods and demons will all see and hail.324.

Lakhs of lances and arrows will be discharged and the banners of all colours will wave in the war-arena, the superb warriors will fall on the enemies taking their shields etc. and in all the ten directions the sound of “kill, kill” will be heard.325.

The armours etc. will be seen flying in the war and the warriors will pitch their column of praise, the lances and arrows will be seen shining in the war-arena, besides the warriors, the ghosts and fiends will also be seen shouting loudly in the war.326.
Somewhere the lances and the arrows will be seen striking the targets, many will be thrown in all the ten directions by catching them from their hair.327.

The warriors of red colour will be seen and the arrows will be struck like the rays of the sun, the glory of the warriors will be of different type and seeing them, the kinsuk flowers will also feel shy.328.

The elephants, horses and chariot-riders will fight in such numbers that the poets will not be able to describe them, their songs of praise will be composed and they will be sung till the end of four ages.329.

584.g: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
584.e: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

584.g: ਰੋਵਹਿ. ਪਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ; ਮੈ. ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
584.e: Those who are separated from their Beloved Husband Lord weep and wail, but my True Husband Lord is always with me.

584.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਚਲਣੁ ਸਹੀ ਜਾਣਿਆ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
584.e: Those who know that they must depart, serve the True Guru, and dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

584.g: ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਲੇ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
584.e: They dwell constantly upon the Naam, and the True Guru is with them; they serve the True Guru, and so obtain peace.

584.g: ਸਬਦੇ. ਕਾਲੁ ਮਾਰਿ, ਸਚੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ; ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ. ਨ ਹੋਇਆ ॥
584.e: Through the Shabad, they kill death, and enshrine the True Lord within their hearts; they shall not have to come and go again.

584.g: ਸਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ; ਵੇਖੈ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ॥
584.e: True is the Lord and Master, and True is His Name; bestowing His Gracious Glance, one is enraptured.

584.g: ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹੁ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ; ਮੈ. ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੜਾ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੧॥
584.e: Those who are separated from their Beloved Husband Lord weep and wail, but my True Husband Lord is always with me. ||1||

584.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੈ; ਕਿਵ ਮਿਲਾਂ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
584.e: God, my Lord and Master, is the highest of all; how can I meet my Dear Beloved?

584.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੀ ਤਾਂ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੀ; ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
584.e: When the True Guru united me, then I was naturally united with my Husband Lord, and now, I keep Him clasped to my heart.

584.g: ਸਦਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ. ਨੇਹੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਪਿਰੁ ਦਿਸੈ ॥
584.e: I constantly, lovingly cherish my Beloved within my heart; through the True Guru, I see my Beloved.

584.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕਾ ਕਚਾ ਚੋਲਾ; ਤਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ. ਪਗੁ ਖਿਸੈ ॥
584.e: The cloak of Maya's love is false; wearing it, one slips and loses his footing.

584.g: ਪਿਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਚੋਲਾ; ਤਿਤੁ ਪੈਧੈ ਤਿਖਾ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
584.e: That cloak is true, which is dyed in the color of the Love of my Beloved; wearing it, my inner thirst is quenched.

584.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਭ ਦੂ ਊਚਾ ਹੈ; ਕਿਉ ਮਿਲਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥੨॥
584.e: God, my Lord and Master, is the highest of all; how can I meet my Dear Beloved? ||2||

584.g: ਮੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥
584.e: I have realized my True Lord God, while the other worthless ones have gone astray.

584.g: ਮੈ ਸਦਾ ਰਾਵੇ ਪਿਰੁ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸਚੜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
584.e: I dwell constantly upon my Beloved Husband Lord, and reflect upon the True Word of the Shabad.

584.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ. ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਨਾਰੇ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
584.e: The bride reflects upon the True Shabad, and is imbued with His Love; she meets with the True Guru, and finds her Beloved.

584.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ. ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤੀ; ਗਇਆ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੂਖੁ ਸਬਾਇਆ ॥
584.e: Deep within, she is imbued with His Love, and intoxicated with delight; her enemies and sufferings are all taken away.

584.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੰਉ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ. ਤਾਂ ਮਨੁ ਭੀਜੈ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥
584.e: Surrender body and soul to your Guru, and then you shall become happy; your thirst and pain shall be taken away.

584.g: ਮੈ ਪਿਰੁ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ; ਹੋਰ ਭੂਲੀ ਅਵਗਣਿਆਰੇ ॥੩॥
584.e: I have realized my True Lord God, while the other worthless ones have gone astray. ||3||

584.g: ਸਚੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ ॥
584.e: The True Lord Himself created the world; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.

584.g: ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
584.e: He Himself unites, and causes us to unite with Him; He Himself blesses us with His Love.

584.g: ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਪਿਆਰੋ. ਸਹਜਿ ਵਾਪਾਰੋ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
584.e: He Himself blesses us with His Love, and deals in celestial peace; the life of the Gurmukh is reformed.

584.g: ਧਨੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ. ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ; ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੋ ॥
584.e: Blessed is his coming into the world; he banishes his self-conceit, and is acclaimed as true in the Court of the True Lord.

584.g: ਗਿਆਨਿ ਰਤਨਿ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਆ; ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
584.e: The light of the jewel of spiritual wisdom shines within his heart, O Nanak, and he loves the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

584.g: ਸਚੜੈ ਆਪਿ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ. ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੋ ॥੪॥੩॥
584.e: The True Lord Himself created the world; without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness. ||4||3||

584.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਈ; ਪਿਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਮਾਲੇ ॥
584.e: O Nanak, that soul-bride is united in Union; she cherishes her Beloved Husband forever, deep within herself.

584.g: ਇਕਿ ਰੋਵਹਿ ਪਿਰਹਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨੀਆ; ਅੰਧੀ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ. ਪਿਰੁ ਹੈ ਨਾਲੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
584.e: Some weep and wail, separated from their Husband Lord; the blind ones do not know that their Husband is with them. ||4||2||

584.g: ਵਡਹੰਸੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
584.e: Wadahans, Third Mehl:

584.g: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਜਰੀ ਹੈ; ਇਸ ਨੋ ਜਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਆਏ ॥
584.e: This body is frail; old age is overtaking it.

584.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ. ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ; ਹੋਰੁ. ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
584.e: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, while others die, to be reincarnated; they continue coming and going.

584.g: ਹੋਰਿ. ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਵਹਿ; ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਹਿ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
584.e: Others die, to be reincarnated; they continue coming and going, and in the end, they depart regretfully. Without the Name, there is no peace.

584.g: ਐਥੈ ਕਮਾਵੈ. ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵੈ; ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਹੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
584.e: As one acts here, so does he obtain his rewards; the self-willed manmukh loses his honor.

584.g: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ. ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰੁ; ਨਾ ਤਿਥੈ ਭੈਣ. ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
584.e: In the City of Death, there is pitch darkness, and huge clouds of dust; neither sister nor brother is there.

584.g: ਇਹੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਜਰੀ ਹੈ; ਇਸ ਨੋ ਜਰੁ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
584.e: This body is frail; old age is overtaking it. ||1||

584.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ; ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
584.e: The body becomes like gold, when the True Guru unites one with Himself.

584.g: ਅਚਲੇਸ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਦਿਸਿ ਧਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਰੁ ਉਘਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਹਥਿਯਾਰ ਦੁਹੂੰ ਦਿਸਿ ਛੂਟਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਸਰ ਓਘ ਰਣੰ ਧਨੁ ਟੂਟਹਿਗੇ ॥੩੩੦॥
584.e: The stable warriors will fall upon their opponents from both sides and will shout “kill, kill” from their mouths, the weapons will strike from both sides and the volleys of arrows will be discharged.330.

584.g: ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲ ਮਨਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
584.e: HARIBOLMANA STANZA

584.g: ਭਟ ਗਾਜਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਘਨ ਲਾਜਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਦਲ ਜੂਟਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਸਰ ਛੂਟਹਿਗੇ ॥੩੩੧॥
584.e: The warriors will shout, the clouds will be shy, the armies will fight and the arrows will be discharged.331.

584.g: ਸਰ ਬਰਖਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਧਨੁ ਕਰਖਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਅਸਿ ਬਾਜਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਰਣਿ ਸਾਜਹਿਗੇ ॥੩੩੨॥
584.e: The warriors will be showered, there will be the twang of the bows, the sworeds will collide and the war will continue.332.

584.g: ਭੂਅ ਡਿਗਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਭਯ ਭਿਗਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਉਠ ਭਾਜਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਨਹੀ ਲਾਜਹਿਗੇ ॥੩੩੩॥
584.e: The earth will thrust in and become fearful, the warriors will run away without getting shy.333.

584.g: ਗਣ ਦੇਖਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਜਯ ਲੇਖਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਮੁਸਕਯਾਵਹਿਗੇ ॥੩੩੪॥
584.e: The ganas will see, they will hail, they will sing praises and smile.334.

584.g: ਪ੍ਰਣ ਪੂਰਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਰਜਿ ਰੂਰਹਿਗੇ ॥
ਰਣਿ ਰਾਜਹਿਗੇ ॥

585.e: Third Mehl:

585.g: ਮੈ ਜਾਨਿਆ. ਵਡ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੈ; ਤਾ. ਮੈ ਕੀਆ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
585.e: I thought that he was a great swan, so I associated with him.

585.g: ਜੇ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਗੁ ਬਪੁੜਾ; ਤ. ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਦੇਦੀ ਅੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
585.e: If I had known that he was only a wretched heron from birth, I would not have touched him. ||2||

585.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਟੀਐ; ਸਚੜੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
585.e: Doubt and Maya have been removed from within me, and I am merged in the Naam, the True Name of the Lord.

585.g: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਏ. ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ; ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
585.e: Merged in the True Name of the Lord, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; meeting my Beloved, I have found peace.

585.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
585.e: I am in constant bliss, day and night; egotism has been dispelled from within me.

585.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਪੁਰਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ; ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਹੰਉ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
585.e: I fall at the feet of those who enshrine the Naam within their consciousness.

585.g: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਕੰਚਨੁ. ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ; ਜਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
585.e: The body becomes like gold, when the True Guru unites one with Himself. ||2||

585.g: ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
585.e: We truly praise the True Lord, when the True Guru imparts understanding.

585.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ. ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀਆ; ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ. ਦੇਸਨਿ ਆਗੈ ਜਾਏ ॥
585.e: Without the True Guru, they are deluded by doubt; going to the world hereafter, what face will they display?

585.g: ਕਿਆ ਦੇਨਿ ਮੁਹੁ ਜਾਏ. ਅਵਗੁਣਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਏ; ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਏ ॥
585.e: What face will they show, when they go there? They will regret and repent for their sins; their actions will bring them only pain and suffering.

585.g: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੀਆ ਸੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲਾ; ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਅੰਕਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
585.e: Those who are imbued with the Naam are dyed in the deep crimson color of the Lord's Love; they merge into the Being of their Husband Lord.

585.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਸੂਝਈ; ਕਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕਹੀਐ ਜਾਏ ॥
585.e: I can conceive of no other as great as the Lord; unto whom should I go and speak?

585.g: ਸੋ ਸਚਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥੩॥
585.e: We truly praise the True Lord, when the True Guru imparts understanding. ||3||

585.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ; ਹੰਉ. ਤਿਨ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥
585.e: I fall at the feet of those who praise the Truest of the True.

585.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ; ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ. ਮਲੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ ॥
585.e: Those humble beings are true, and immaculately pure; meeting them, all filth is washed off.

585.g: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ. ਮਲੁ ਸਭ ਜਾਏ. ਸਚੈ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਏ; ਸਚੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
585.e: Meeting them, all filth is washed off; bathing in the Pool of Truth, one becomes truthful, with intuitive ease.

585.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਏ ॥
585.e: The True Guru has given me the realization of the Naam, the Immaculate Name of the Lord, the unfathomable, the imperceptible.

585.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
585.e: Those who perform devotional worship to the Lord night and day, are imbued with His Love; O Nanak, they are absorbed in the True Lord.

585.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੜਾ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਹੰਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਏ ॥੪॥੪॥
585.e: I fall at the feet of those who meditate on the Truest of the True. ||4||4||

585.g: ਵਡਹੰਸ ਕੀ ਵਾਰ ਮਹਲਾ ੪, ਲਲਾਂ ਬਹਲੀਮਾ ਕੀ ਧੁਨਿ, ਗਾਵਣੀ ॥
585.e: Vaar Of Wadahans, Fourth Mehl: To Be Sung In The Tune Of Lalaa-Behleemaa:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Salok, Third Mehl:

585.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਵਡ ਹੰਸ ਹੈ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
585.e: The great swans are imbued with the Word of the Shabad; they enshrine the True Name within their hearts.

585.g: ਸਚੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਹਿ. ਸਦ ਸਚਿ ਰਹਹਿ; ਸਚੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
585.e: They gather Truth, remain always in Truth, and love the True Name.

585.g: ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ. ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ; ਨਦਰਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
585.e: They are always pure and immaculate - filth does not touch them; they are blessed with the Grace of the Creator Lord.

585.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ. ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ; ਜੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਹਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
585.e: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who, night and day, meditate on the Lord. ||1||
Pauree:

585.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਆਪਿ. ਆਪਿ ਹੈ; ਆਪਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
585.e: You Yourself are Yourself, all by Yourself; You Yourself created the creation.

585.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਬੀਆ ॥
585.e: You Yourself are Yourself the Formless Lord; there is no other than You.

585.g: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ; ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
585.e: You are the all-powerful Cause of causes; what You do, comes to be.

585.g: ਤੂ ਅਣਮੰਗਿਆ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਵਣਾ; ਸਭਨਾਹਾ ਜੀਆ ॥
585.e: You give gifts to all beings, without their asking.

585.g: ਸਭਿ ਆਖਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥
585.e: Everyone proclaims, "Waaho! Waaho!" Blessed, blessed is the True Guru, who has given the supreme gift of the Name of the Lord. ||1||
The warriors will fulful their promises and will look beautiful, even the gods will feel shy from them in the war-arena.335.
In their fury, they will discharged arrows, during their fighting in the war, their swords will break.336.
The warriors will thunder, and not run away, they will strike their blows with swords and will knock down their enemies.337.
The horses will fight, the warriors will be killed and will ferry across the world-ocean.338.
The gods will see and hail: they will utter “Bravo, Bravo” and will be pleased in their mind.339.
The Lord is the cause of all victories and the remover of the enemies, He is the destroyer of the tyrants and is Full of Glory.340.
He is the giver of suffering to the tyrants and is the ornamentation of the world, the praiseworthy Lord is the punisher of the enemies.341.
He is the destroyer of the armies and is the striker of the sword, He is the creator of the world and also its supporter.342.
He is Bewitching and Glorious, He is the Affliction-Giver for the enemies and the world remembers Him.343.
He is the masher of the enemy and fulfiller of the promise, He showers the arrows with His bow.344.
He is the Fascinator of women, Glorious and elegant, He allures the mind like the clouds of Sawan.345.
He is the ornament of the world and is the sustainer of tradition, he is cool like the moon and bright-faced like the sun.346.
Third Mehl:

585.g: ਹੰਸਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਤਰੰਦਿਆ; ਬਗਾਂ ਭਿ ਆਯਾ ਚਾਉ ॥
585.e: Seeing the swans swimming, the herons became envious.

585.g: ਡੁਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਗ ਬਪੁੜੇ; ਸਿਰੁ ਤਲਿ. ਉਪਰਿ ਪਾਉ ॥੩॥
585.e: But the poor herons drowned and died, and floated with their heads down, and their feet above. ||3||

586.e: Salok, Third Mehl:

586.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਚਾਕਰੀ; ਸੁਖੀ ਹੂੰ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
586.e: Service to, and obedience to the True Guru, is the essence of comfort and peace.

586.g: ਐਥੈ ਮਿਲਨਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ; ਦਰਗਹ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
586.e: Doing so, one obtains honor here, and the door of salvation in the Court of the Lord.

586.g: ਸਚੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ; ਸਚੁ ਪੈਨਣੁ. ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
586.e: In this way, perform the tasks of Truth, wear Truth, and take the Support of the True Name.

586.g: ਸਚੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
586.e: Associating with Truth, obtain Truth, and love the True Name.

586.g: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਖੁ ਸਦਾ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਚਿਆਰੁ ॥
586.e: Through the True Word of the Shabad, be always happy, and you shall be acclaimed as True in the True Court.

586.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੈ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
586.e: O Nanak, he alone serves the True Guru, whom the Creator has blessed with His Glance of Grace. ||1||
Salok, Third Mehl:

586.g: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ. ਸਭੁ ਆਕਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਨਿਰਭਉ. ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਸੋਇ ॥
586.e: The entire universe is in fear; only the Dear Lord is fearless.

586.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ. ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਤਿਥੈ ਭਉ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
586.e: Serving the True Guru, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind, and then, fear cannot stay there.

586.g: ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ. ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਪੋਹਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
586.e: Enemies and pain cannot come close, and no one can touch him.

586.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿਆ; ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
586.e: The Gurmukh reflects upon the Lord in his mind; whatever pleases the Lord - that alone comes to pass.

586.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਖਸੀ; ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
586.e: O Nanak, He Himself preserves one's honor; He alone resolves our affairs. ||1||
He comes and gives comfort and happiness, seeing he thick clouds, he gets pleased like the peacock.347.
He is Merciful Lord of the world, He is the ornament of the universe and the remover of suffering.348.
He is the allurer of women and most beautiful, seeing his charming eyes, the deer are getting shy.349.
His eyes are like the deer’s eyes and lotus, He is full of Mercy and Glory.350.
He is the cause of the Iron Age and the redeemer of the world, He is Beauty-incarnate and even the gods become shy on seeing Him.351.
Heis the worshipper of the sword and the Destroyer of the enemy, He is the giver of happiness and killer of the enemy.352.
He is the Yaksha of water and the fulfiller of the promise, He is the Destroyer of the enemy and the masher of his pride.353.
He is the creator and support of the earth and by pulling His bow, He showers the arrows.354.
He glorious with the elegance of lakhs of moons, He is the Fascinatior of women with His Glorious Elegance.355.
He has red colour, He supports the Earth and has infinite Glory.356.
He is the field of Refuge, the Killer of the enemy, Most Glorious and Most Charming.357.
His Beauty captivates he mind, He is the Cause of the causes of the world and is Full of Mercy.358.
Salok, Third Mehl:

586.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ; ਭੇਖੀ. ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
586.e: Meeting with the True Guru, hunger departs; by wearing the robes of a beggar, hunger does not depart.
Third Mehl:

586.g: ਹੋਰ ਵਿਡਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ. ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਵਾਸੁ ॥
586.e: Cursed is the life, and cursed is the dwelling, of those who serve another.

586.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਛੋਡਿ. ਬਿਖੁ ਲਗੇ; ਬਿਖੁ ਖਟਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
586.e: Abandoning the Ambrosial Nectar, they turn to poison; they earn poison, and poison is their only wealth.

586.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਬਿਖੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ; ਬਿਖੁ ਕੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਿਰਾਸ ॥
586.e: Poison is their food, and poison is their dress; they fill their mouths with morsels of poison.

586.g: ਐਥੈ ਦੁਖੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ; ਮੁਇਆ ਨਰਕਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
586.e: In this world, they earn only pain and suffering, and dying, they go to abide in hell.

586.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਹਿ ਮੈਲੈ. ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਕਾਮ ਕਰੋਧਿ ਵਿਣਾਸੁ ॥
586.e: The self-willed manmukhs have filthy faces; they do not know the Word of the Shabad; in sexual desire and anger they waste away.

586.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਛੋਡਿਆ; ਮਨਹਠਿ ਕੰਮੁ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
586.e: They forsake the Fear of the True Guru, and because of their stubborn ego, their efforts do not come to fruition.

586.g: ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ; ਕੋ ਨ ਸੁਣੇ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥
586.e: In the City of Death, they are bound and beaten, and no one hears their prayers.

586.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੨॥
586.e: O Nanak, they act according to their pre-ordained destiny; the Gurmukh abides in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||
Pauree:

586.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਜਣੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
586.e: Meet with that True Guru, the True Friend, within whose mind the Lord, the virtuous One, abides.

586.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੀਐ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
586.e: Meet with that Beloved True Guru, who has subdued ego from within himself.

586.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਦੇ. ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
586.e: Blessed, blessed is the Perfect True Guru, who has given the Lord's Teachings to reform the whole world.

586.g: ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ; ਭਉਜਲ ਬਿਖੁ ਤਾਰੀ ॥
586.e: O Saints, meditate constantly on the Lord's Name, and cross over the terrifying, poisonous world-ocean.

586.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟੜਿਅਹੁ ਹੰਉ ਸਦ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
586.e: The Perfect Guru has taught me about the Lord; I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru. ||2||
Third Mehl:

586.g: ਇਕਿ ਸਜਣ ਚਲੇ. ਇਕਿ ਚਲਿ ਗਏ; ਰਹਦੇ ਭੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
586.e: Some friends are leaving, some have already left, and those remaining will eventually leave.

586.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਨ ਸੇਵਿਓ; ਸੇ ਆਇ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਹਿ ॥
586.e: Those who do not serve the True Guru, come and go regretting.

586.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ. ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
586.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to Truth are not separated; serving the True Guru, they merge into the Lord. ||2||
Pauree:

586.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਸਾਧ ਜਨੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
586.e: Serve the True Guru, O Holy people; He implants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in our minds.

586.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ; ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗੰਨਾਥੁ ਜਗਦੀਸੁ ਜਪਾਇਆ ॥
586.e: Worship the True Guru day and night; He leads us the meditate on the Lord of the Universe, the Master of the Universe.

586.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਬਤਾਇਆ ॥
586.e: Behold the True Guru, each and every moment; He shows us the Divine Path of the Lord.

586.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਪਗੀ ਪਵਹੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਮੋਹ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਆ ॥
586.e: Let everyone fall at the feet of the True Guru; He has dispelled the darkness of emotional attachment.

586.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਲਹਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
586.e: Let everyone hail and praise the True Guru, who has led us to find the treasure of the Lord's devotional worship. ||3||

587.e: Pauree:

587.g: ਤਿਤੁ ਜਾਇ ਬਹਹੁ ਸਤਸੰਗਤੀ; ਜਿਥੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਲੋਈਐ ॥
587.e: Go, and sit in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, where the Name of the Lord is churned.

587.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਤਤੁ. ਨ ਖੋਈਐ ॥
587.e: In peace and poise, contemplate the Lord's Name - don't lose the essence of the Lord.

587.g: ਨਿਤ ਜਪਿਅਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਢੋਈਐ ॥
587.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, constantly, day and night, and you shall be accepted in the Court of the Lord.

587.g: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੂ ਜਿਸੁ; ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖੋਈਐ ॥
587.e: He alone finds the Perfect True Guru, on whose forehead such a pre-ordained destiny is written.

587.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੰਉ. ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਹੁ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਲ ਗਲੋਈਐ ॥੪॥
587.e: Let everyone bow in worship to the Guru, who utters the sermon of the Lord. ||4||
Third Mehl:

587.g: ਇਕਿ. ਸਦਾ ਇਕਤੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਹਹਿ; ਤਿਨ ਕੈ. ਹਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
587.e: Some remain constantly imbued with the Lord's Love; I am forever a sacrifice to them.

587.g: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਰਪੀ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ; ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
587.e: I dedicate my mind, soul and wealth to them; bowing low, I fall at their feet.

587.g: ਤਿਨ ਮਿਲਿਆ. ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
587.e: Meeting them, the soul is satisfied, and one's hunger and thirst all depart.

587.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਦਾ; ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
587.e: O Nanak, those who are attuned to the Naam are happy forever; they lovingly focus their minds on the True Lord. ||2||
Pauree:

587.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ. ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ. ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
587.e: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who recites the sermon of the Lord's Teachings.
SANGEET BHUJANG PRAYAAT STANZA
The warriors are fighting in the war and the arrows are being discharged, the horse-riders are fighting in the battlefield and in their fury, they are absorbed in fighting.361.
The dreadful fighting continues and the warriors have got enraged, the warriors are striking their lances and are dismounting the fighters from their horses.362.
The soldiers have discharged the arrows and the horses have been killed and the fast-moving horses jumped and ran away.363.
The battlefield was saturated with blood and the warriors became unconscious during their fight, the fighters arise, get enraged and strike blows in great excitement.364.
Shiva is dancing and the cowards are running away, the warriors are fighting and are being struck by the arrows.365.
The warriors are absorbed in fighting and the heavenly damsels are moving for wedding them, the warriors are looking at them and they are also fascinated by them.366.
Their beauty allures the lovers like falling in the well, wherefrom they can never come out, these heavenly damsels have also drowned themselves in the sexual love of the beautiful warriors.367.
The women are getting allured and there is brightness of their elegance, the warriors seeing them are playing on various kinds of musical instruments.368.
The women, full of beauty and lust are dancing and the warriors, getting pleased are wedding them.369.
The king, getting infuriated, manifested himself as KAL (death) and in his anger, quickly advanced forward.370.
He is of such Captivating Beauty as if He is the god of love, His Brightness defeats the moon’s glory.359.
He is the worshipper of the sword and the Destroyer of the enemy, He is the Lord bestower of the boon.360.

587.g: ਦੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ; ਅਗੈ ਦੂਣੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
587.e: Afflicted with pain, he wanders from house to house, and in the world hereafter, he receives double punishment.

587.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਹਜੁ. ਨ ਆਇਓ; ਸਹਜੇ ਹੀ ਲੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
587.e: Peace does not come to his heart - he is not content to eat what comes his way.

587.g: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਮੰਗਣਾ; ਲੈਣਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਨਾਇ ॥
587.e: With his stubborn mind, he begs, and grabs, and annoys those who give.

587.g: ਇਸੁ ਭੇਖੈ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਗਿਰਹੋ ਭਲਾ; ਜਿਥਹੁ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਇ ॥
587.e: Instead of wearing these beggar's robes, it is better to be a householder, and give to others.

587.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਈ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇ ॥
587.e: Those who are attuned to the Word of the Shabad, acquire understanding; the others wander, deluded by doubt.

587.g: ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ; ਕਹਣਾ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
587.e: They act according to their past actions; it is useless to talk to them.

587.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ; ਜਿਨ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਥਾਇ ॥੧॥
587.e: O Nanak, those who are pleasing unto the Lord are good; He upholds their honor. ||1||
Third Mehl:

587.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ; ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
587.e: Serving the True Guru, one finds a lasting peace; the pains of birth and death are removed.

587.g: ਚਿੰਤਾ. ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
587.e: He is not troubled by anxiety, and the carefree Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

587.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
587.e: Deep within himself, is the sacred shrine of spiritual wisdom, revealed by the True Guru.

587.g: ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਆ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
587.e: His filth is removed, and his soul becomes immaculately pure, bathing in the sacred shrine, the pool of Ambrosial Nectar.

587.g: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਜਣਾ; ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
587.e: The friend meets with the True Friend, the Lord, through the love of the Shabad.

587.g: ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਚਾ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
587.e: Within the home of his own being, he finds the Divine Self, and his light blends with the Light.

587.g: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ. ਜਮਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਈ; ਲੈ ਜਾਸੀ ਪਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
587.e: The Messenger of Death does not leave the hypocrite; he is led away in dishonor.

587.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ; ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
587.e: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam are saved; they are in love with the True Lord. ||2||
Salok, Third Mehl:

587.g: ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਜਣਾ; ਜਿਨ ਸਤਗੁਰ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
587.e: The friends who love the True Guru, meet with the Lord, the True Friend.

587.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਤਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਸਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
587.e: Meeting their Beloved, they meditate on the True Lord with love and affection.

587.g: ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
587.e: Their minds are appeased by their own minds, through the incomparable Word of the Guru's Shabad.

587.g: ਏਹਿ ਸਜਣ ਮਿਲੇ. ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ; ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
587.e: These friends are united, and will not be separated again; they have been united by the Creator Lord Himself.

587.g: ਇਕਨਾ. ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ, ਨ ਆਈਆ; ਸਬਦਿ. ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
587.e: Some do not believe in the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan; they do not contemplate the Shabad.

587.g: ਵਿਛੁੜਿਆ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਵਿਛੁੜੈ; ਜਿਨਾ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
587.e: The separated ones are in love with duality - what more separation can they suffer?

587.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੇਤੀ ਦੋਸਤੀ; ਥੋੜੜਿਆ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
587.e: Friendship with the self-willed manmukhs lasts for only a few short days.

587.g: ਇਸੁ ਪਰੀਤੀ ਤੁਟਦੀ. ਵਿਲਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਇਤੁ ਦੋਸਤੀ ਚਲਨਿ ਵਿਕਾਰ ॥
587.e: This friendship is broken in an instant; this friendship leads to corruption.

587.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਨਾਹੀ; ਨਾਮਿ. ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
587.e: They do not fear the True Lord within their hearts, and they do not love the Naam.

587.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਚੈ ਦੋਸਤੀ; ਜਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
587.e: O Nanak, why become friends with those whom the Creator Lord Himself has misled? ||1||

588.e: Third Mehl:

588.g: ਏਹਾ ਕਾਇਆ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ. ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
588.e: This body is filled with disease; without the Word of the Shabad, the pain of the disease of ego does not depart.

588.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤਾ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੋਵੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
588.e: When one meets the True Guru, then he becomes immaculately pure, and he enshrines the Lord's Name within his mind.

588.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ; ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
588.e: O Nanak, meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Peace-Giving Lord, his pains are automatically forgotten. ||2||

588.g: ਦੋਹਰਾ ॥
588.e: DOHRA

588.g: ਅਸਿ ਟੁਟੇ ਲੁਟੇ ਘਨੇ; ਤੁਟੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਨੇਕ ॥
ਜੇ ਜੁਟੇ ਕੁਟੇ ਸਬੈ; ਰਹਿ ਗਯੋ ਭੂਪਤਿ ਏਕ ॥੩੭੫॥
588.e: The swords broke and many weapons were shattered into bits, those warriors who fought, were chopped and ultimately only the king survived.375.

588.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
588.e: Pauree:

588.g: ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ; ਤਿਨੀ ਪਾਇਅੜੇ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ॥
588.e: Those who meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, obtain all peace and comforts.

588.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਸਫਲੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਮਨਿ ਲਾਗੀ ਭੁਖਾ ॥
588.e: Fruitful is the entire life of those, who hunger for the Name of the Lord in their minds.

588.g: ਜਿਨੀ. ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਚਨਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ; ਤਿਨ. ਵਿਸਰਿ ਗਏ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖਾ ॥
588.e: Those who worship the Lord in adoration, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, forget all their pains and suffering.

588.g: ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨ. ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ਚੁਖਾ ॥
588.e: Those Gursikhs are good Saints, who care for nothing other than the Lord.

588.g: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਮੁਖਾ ॥੬॥
588.e: Blessed, blessed is their Guru, whose mouth tastes the Ambrosial Fruit of the Lord's Name. ||6||

588.g: ਪੰਕਜ ਬਾਟਿਕਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
588.e: PANKAJ VAATIKA STANZA

588.g: ਸੈਨ ਜੁਝਤ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਭਯੋ ਅਤਿ ਆਕੁਲ ॥
ਧਾਵਤ ਭਯੋ ਸਾਮੁਹਿ ਅਤਿ ਬਿਆਕੁਲ ॥
588.e: On the destruction of his army, the king extremely agitated went forward and came at the front

588.g: ਸੰਨਿਧ ਹ੍ਵੈ ਚਿਤ ਮੈ ਅਤਿ ਕ੍ਰੁਧਤ ॥
ਆਵਤ ਭਯੋ ਰਿਸ ਕੈ ਕਰਿ ਜੁਧਤ ॥੩੭੬॥
588.e: Getting extremely angry in his mind and moved forward in order to fight.376.

588.g: ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰੇ ਤਬ ॥
ਜੰਗ ਜੁਟਿਓ ਅਪਨੋ ਦਲ ਲੈ ਸਬ ॥
588.e: Taking his other forces with him, he struck blows in many ways

588.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
588.e: Salok, Third Mehl:

588.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਾਧੀ ਜਲਿ ਮੁਈ; ਜਲਿ ਜਲਿ ਕਰੇ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
588.e: Consumed by desires, the world is burning and dying; burning and burning, it cries out.

588.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੀਤਲ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਜਲੈ ਨ. ਦੂਜੀ ਵਾਰ ॥
588.e: But if it meets with the cooling and soothing True Guru, it does not burn any longer.

588.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ, ਨਿਰਭਉ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਜਿਚਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ. ਨ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
588.e: O Nanak, without the Name, and without contemplating the Word of the Shabad, no one becomes fearless. ||1||

588.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ. ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ॥
588.e: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru, who has led me to serve the Lord.

588.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ. ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ਹੈ; ਜਿਥੈ ਕਿਥੈ ਮੈਨੋ ਲਏ ਛਡਾਈ ॥
588.e: That Beloved True Guru is always with me; wherever I may be, He will save me.

588.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
588.e: Most blessed is that Guru, who imparts understanding of the Lord.

588.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਗੁਰ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ. ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੀਆ; ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਆਸ ਪੁਰਾਈ ॥੫॥
588.e: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has given me the Lord's Name, and fulfilled the desires of my mind. ||5||

588.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
588.e: Salok, Third Mehl:

588.g: ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਜੰਦਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
588.e: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Messenger of Death is the enemy of life, but he acts according to the Lord's Command.

588.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ; ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
588.e: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, while the self-willed manmukhs receive their punishment.

588.g: ਜਮਕਾਲੈ ਵਸਿ ਜਗੁ ਬਾਂਧਿਆ; ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਫਰੂ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
588.e: The world is under the control, and in the bondage of the Messenger of Death; no one can hold him back.

588.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਮੁ ਕੀਤਾ ਸੋ ਸੇਵੀਐ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
588.e: So serve the One who created Death; as Gurmukh, no pain shall touch you.

588.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਜਮੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ; ਜਿਨ ਮਨਿ ਸਚਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
588.e: O Nanak, Death serves the Gurmukhs; the True Lord abides in their minds. ||1||

588.g: ਜਾਗੜਦੰ ਜੁਝੇ ਖਾਗੜਦੰ ਖੇਤੰ ॥
ਰਾਗੜਦੰ ਰਹਸੇ ਪਾਗੜਦੰ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੰ ॥੩੭੧॥
588.e: The warriors shouted, the horses danced, the fighters died and the ghosts etc. became pleased.371.

588.g: ਮਾਗੜਦੰ ਮਾਰੇ ਬਾਗੜਦੰ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
ਪਾਗੜਦੰ ਪਰਾਨੇ ਭਾਗੜਦੰ ਭੀਰੰ ॥
ਧਾਗੜਦੰ ਧਾਯੋ ਰਾਗੜਦੰ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
ਰਾਗੜਦੰ ਰਣਕੇ ਬਾਗੜਦੰ ਬਾਜਾ ॥੩੭੨॥
588.e: The warriors were being killed and the cowards began to run away, the king also fell upon the opponents and the musical instruments of war were played.372.

588.g: ਟਾਗੜਦੰ ਟੂਟੇ ਤਾਗੜਦੰ ਤਾਲੰ ॥
ਆਗੜਦੰ ਉਠੇ ਜਾਗੜਦੰ ਜੁਆਲੰ ॥
ਭਾਗੜਦੰ ਭਾਜੇ ਬਾਗੜਦੰ ਬੀਰੰ ॥
ਲਾਗੜਦੰ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਾਗੜਦੰ ਤੀਰੰ ॥੩੭੩॥
588.e: The swords were broken and fires blazed, with the infliction of arrows the warriors ran hither and thither.373.

588.g: ਰਾਗੜਦੰ ਰਹਸੀ ਦਾਗੜਦੰ ਦੇਵੀ ॥
ਗਾਗੜਦੰ ਗੈਣ ਆਗੜਦੰ ਭੇਵੀ ॥
ਭਾਗੜਦੰ ਭੈਰੰ ਭਾਗੜਦੰ ਪ੍ਰੇਤੰ ॥
ਹਾਗੜਦੰ ਹਸੇ ਖਾਗੜਦੰ ਖੇਤੰ ॥੩੭੪॥
588.e: Seeing the war, the goddess Kali also pleased in the sky, the Bhairav and ghosts etc. also in the battlefield.374.

588.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
588.e: Pauree:

588.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਹਉ ਸਦਾ ਘੁਮਾਇਆ ॥
588.e: I am forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has taught me about the Lord, the Life of the World.

588.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ. ਹਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ; ਜਿਨਿ. ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥
588.e: I am every bit a sacrifice to the Guru, the Lover of Nectar, who has revealed the Name of the Lord.

588.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ. ਹਉ ਵਾਰਣੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
588.e: I am a sacrifice to the Guru, who has totally cured me of the fatal disease of egotism.

588.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ. ਵਡ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨਿ ਅਵਗਣ ਕਟਿ. ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥
588.e: Glorious and great are the virtues of the Guru, who has eradicated evil, and instructed me in virtue.
Third Mehl:

588.g: ਭੇਖੀ. ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ; ਚਿੰਤਾ ਹੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
588.e: Wearing ceremonial robes, the fire is not quenched, and the mind is filled with anxiety.

588.g: ਵਰਮੀ ਮਾਰੀ. ਸਾਪੁ ਨਾ ਮਰੈ; ਤਿਉ. ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
588.e: Destroying the snake's hole, the snake is not killed; it is just like doing deeds without a Guru.

588.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ; ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
588.e: Serving the Giver, the True Guru, the Shabad comes to abide in the mind.

588.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਇ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
588.e: The mind and body are cooled and soothed; peace ensues, and the fire of desire is quenched.

588.g: ਸੁਖਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ; ਜਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
588.e: The supreme comforts and lasting peace are obtained, when one eradicates ego from within.

588.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ; ਜਿ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
588.e: He alone becomes a detached Gurmukh, who lovingly focuses his consciousness on the True Lord.

588.g: ਚਿੰਤਾ. ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਜਾ ਆਘਾਇ ॥
588.e: Anxiety does not affect him at all; he is satisfied and satiated with the Name of the Lord.

588.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ, ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀਐ; ਹਉਮੈ ਪਚਹਿ ਪਚਾਇ ॥੨॥
588.e: O Nanak, without the Naam, no one is saved; they are utterly ruined by egotism. ||2||

589.g: ਬਾਜ ਉਠੇ ਤਹ ਕੋਟਿ ਨਗਾਰੇ ॥
ਰੁਝ ਗਿਰੇ ਰਣ ਜੁਝ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੩੭੭॥
589.e: Many trumpets sounded there and the onlookers of war, also fell down in fear.377.

589.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
589.e: Pauree:

589.g: ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਦਾ; ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
589.e: You, O Creator, know all things; all beings belong to You.

589.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਿ ਲੈਹਿ; ਕਿਆ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
589.e: Those who are pleasing to You, You unite with Yourself; what can the poor creatures do?

589.g: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹੈ; ਸਚੁ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
589.e: You are all-powerful, the Cause of causes, the True Creator Lord.

589.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ, ਸੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
589.e: Only those unite with you, Beloved Lord, whom you approve and who meditate on Guru's Word.

589.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਆਪਣੇ; ਜਿਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਰੇ ॥੮॥
589.e: I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has allowed me to see my unseen Lord. ||8||

589.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
589.e: Pauree:

589.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਹਿਰਦਾ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਸਭਿ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੀ ॥
589.e: Let all bow in reverence, to that humble being whose heart is pure within.

589.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ. ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥
589.e: I am a sacrifice to that humble being whose mind is filled with the treasure of the Naam.

589.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਬੇਕੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥
589.e: He has a discriminating intellect; he meditates on the Name of the Lord.

589.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਤੁ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
589.e: That True Guru is a friend to all; everyone is dear to Him.

589.g: ਸਭੁ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਬੁਧਿ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥੯॥
589.e: The Lord, the Supreme Soul, is pervading everywhere; reflect upon the wisdom of the Guru's Teachings. ||9||

589.g: ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਭਾਗੁ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
589.e: The True Guru meets with those upon whose foreheads such blessed destiny is recorded. ||7||

589.g: ਸਵੈਯਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
589.e: SWAYYA STANZA

589.g: ਆਵਤ ਹੀ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਕੇ ਦਲ ਤੇ; ਹਰਿ ਬਾਜ ਕਰੀ ਰਥ ਕੋਟਿਕ ਕੂਟੇ ॥
ਸਾਜ ਗਿਰੇ ਨ੍ਰਿਪ ਰਾਜ ਕਹੂੰ; ਬਰ ਬਾਜ ਫਿਰੈ ਹਿਹਨਾਵਤ ਛੂਟੇ ॥
589.e: On the arrival of the army of the king, the Lord (Kalki) chopped many elephants, horses and chariots, the horses bedecked by the king were roaming in the battlefield,

589.g: ਨਰਾਜ ਛੰਦ ॥
589.e: NARAAJ STANZA

589.g: ਸਾਜ ਸਾਜ ਕੈ ਸਬੈ ਸਲਾਜ ਬੀਰ ਧਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
ਜੂਝਿ ਜੂਝ ਕੇ ਮਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਲੋਕ ਲੋਕ ਪਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
589.e: All the warriors getting bedecked are falling upon the enemy and after fighting in the war, they reach heaven

589.g: ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ ਹਠੀ ਅਘਾਇ ਘਾਇ ਝੇਲਹੀਂ ॥
ਪਛੇਲ ਪਾਵ ਨ ਚਲੈ ਅਰੈਲ ਬੀਰ ਠੇਲਹੀਂ ॥੩੮੪॥
589.e: The persistent warriors run forward and endure the anguish of the wounds, their feet do not fall back and they are driving other warriors ahead.384.

589.g: ਕੋਪ ਓਪ ਦੈ ਸਬੈ; ਸਰੋਖ ਸੂਰ ਧਾਇ ਹੈਂ ॥
ਧਾਇ ਧਾਇ ਜੂਝ ਹੈਂ; ਅਰੂਝਿ ਜੂਝਿ ਜਾਇ ਹੈਂ ॥
589.e: All the warriors are moving forward in anger and are embracing martyrdom in the battlefield

589.g: ਸੁ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਮੇਲ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰ ਆਨਿ ਡਾਰਹੀਂ ॥
ਨ ਭਾਜਿ ਗਾਜ ਹੈ ਹਠੀ ਨਿਸੰਕ ਘਾਇ ਮਾਰਹੀਂ ॥੩੮੫॥
589.e: Colliding their arms and weapons, they are striking blows and the stable warriors, who do not think of running away, are striking blows, persistently thundering fearlessly.385.

589.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਢੋਲ ਬਾਸੁਰੀ; ਸਨਾਇ ਝਾਝ ਬਾਜ ਹੈਂ ॥
ਸੁ ਪਾਵ ਰੋਪ ਕੈ ਬਲੀ; ਸਕੋਪ ਆਨਿ ਗਾਜ ਹੈਂ ॥
589.e: The small and big drums, flutes, anklets etc. are creating sounds and the warriors firmly putting their feet on the earth are thundering angrily

589.g: ਸੁ ਬੂਝਿ ਬੂਝ ਕੈ ਹਠੀ; ਅਰੂਝਿ ਆਨਿ ਜੂਝ ਹੈਂ ॥
ਸੁ ਅੰਧ ਧੁੰਧ ਹੁਇ ਰਹੀ; ਦਿਸਾ ਵਿਸਾ ਨ ਸੂਝ ਹੈਂ ॥੩੮੬॥
589.e: The persistent warriors recognizing others are entangled with them and there is such a run in the battlefield that the directions are not being comprehended.386.

589.g: ਸਰੋਖ ਕਾਲਿ ਕੇਸਰੀ; ਸੰਘਾਰਿ ਸੈਣ ਧਾਇ ਹੈਂ ॥
ਅਗਸਤ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਕੀ ਜਿਮੰ; ਪਚਾਇ ਸੈਨ ਜਾਇ ਹੈਂ ॥
589.e: The lion of the goddess Kali, in order to kill the army, is running angrily in this way and wants to destroy the army in this way just as the sage August had completely drunk the ocean

589.g: ਸੰਘਾਰਿ ਬਾਹਣੀਸ ਕੋ; ਅਨੀਸ ਤੀਰ ਗਾਜ ਹੈਂ ॥
ਬਿਸੇਖ ਜੁਧ ਮੰਡ ਹੈ; ਅਸੇਖ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਬਾਜ ਹੈਂ ॥੩੮੭॥
589.e: After killing the forces, the warriors are thundering and in the dreadful fight, their weapons are colliding.387.
Third Mehl:

589.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ. ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ. ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
589.e: They do not serve the True Guru, and they do not embrace love for the Lord's Name.

589.g: ਮਤ ਤੁਮ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਓਇ ਜੀਵਦੇ; ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਮਾਰੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥
589.e: Do not even think that they are alive - the Creator Lord Himself has killed them.

589.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ; ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
589.e: Egotism is such a terrible disease; in the love of duality, they do their deeds.

589.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਮੁਏ; ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ. ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
589.e: O Nanak, the self-willed manmukhs are in a living death; forgetting the Lord, they suffer in pain. ||2||

589.g: ਚਾਮਰ ਛੰਦ ॥
589.e: CHAAMAR STANZA

589.g: ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਅਸਤ੍ਰ ਲੈ ਸਕੋਪ; ਬੀਰ ਬੋਲਿ ਕੈ ਸਬੈ ॥
ਕੋਪ ਓਪ ਦੈ ਹਠੀ; ਸੁ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ ਪਰੇ ਸਬੈ ॥
589.e: All the warriors in their fury, took their arms and weapons in their hands, moved forward with persistence and shouting loudly fell upon the opponents

589.g: ਕਾਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਨ ਬਾਨ; ਤਾਨਿ ਤਾਨਿ ਤੋਰ ਹੀ ॥
ਸੁ ਜੂਝਿ ਜੂਝ ਕੈ ਪਰੈ; ਨ ਨੈਕੁ ਮੁਖ ਮੋਰ ਹੀ ॥੩੭੮॥
589.e: The pulled their bows upto their ears and discharged their arrows and without moving backward even slightly they fought and fell.378.

589.g: ਬਾਨ ਪਾਨਿ ਲੈ ਸਬੈ; ਸਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਸੂਰਮਾ ਚਲੇ ॥
ਬੀਨਿ ਬੀਨਿ ਜੇ ਲਏ; ਪ੍ਰਬੀਨ ਬੀਰਹਾ ਭਲੇ ॥
589.e: Taking angrily there bows an arrows in there hand they moved and the worriers were killed silectivly

589.g: ਸੰਕ ਛੋਰ ਕੈ ਭਿਰੈ; ਨਿਸੰਕ ਘਾਇ ਡਾਰ ਹੀ ॥
ਸੁ ਅੰਗ ਭੰਗ ਹੁਇ ਗਿਰੈਂ; ਨ ਜੰਗ ਤੇ ਪਧਾਰ ਹੀ ॥੩੭੯॥
589.e: They were all fearlessly inflicting wounds and their limbs are falling down, but still they did not run away from the battlefield.379.
Third Mehl:

589.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ. ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ; ਕਿਆ ਓਹੁ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
589.e: He does not serve the True Guru; how can he reflect upon the Lord?

589.g: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਈ; ਬਿਖੁ ਭੂਲਾ ਗਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
589.e: He does not appreciate the value of the Shabad; the fool wanders in corruption and sin.

589.g: ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਬਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ; ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
589.e: The blind and ignorant perform all sorts of ritualistic actions; they are in love with duality.

589.g: ਅਣਹੋਦਾ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ; ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
589.e: Those who take unjustified pride in themselves, are punished and humiliated by the Messenger of Death.

589.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਖੀਐ; ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
589.e: O Nanak, who else is there to ask? The Lord Himself is the Forgiver. ||2||

589.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
589.e: Salok, Third Mehl:

589.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਜੀਅ ਕੇ ਬੰਧਨਾ; ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
589.e: Without serving the True Guru, the soul is in the bondage of deeds done in ego.

589.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹੀ; ਮਰਿ; ਜੰਮਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
589.e: Without serving the True Guru, one finds no place of rest; he dies, and is reincarnated, and continues coming and going.

589.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ; ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
589.e: Without serving the True Guru, one's speech is vapid and insipid; the Naam, the Name of the Lord, does not abide in his mind.

589.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
589.e: Salok, Third Mehl:

589.g: ਰਤਨਾ ਪਾਰਖੁ ਜੋ ਹੋਵੈ; ਸੁ ਰਤਨਾ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
589.e: He is the Assayer of jewels; He contemplates the jewel.

589.g: ਰਤਨਾ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਣਈ; ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਅੰਧਾਰੁ ॥
589.e: He is ignorant and totally blind - he does not appreciate the value of the jewel.

589.g: ਰਤਨੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ; ਬੂਝੈ ਬੂਝਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
589.e: The Jewel is the Word of the Guru's Shabad; the Knower alone knows it.

589.g: ਮੂਰਖ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਦੇ; ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
589.e: The fools take pride in themselves, and are ruined in birth and death.

589.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਤਨਾ ਸੋ ਲਹੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
589.e: O Nanak, he alone obtains the jewel, who, as Gurmukh, enshrines love for it.

589.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਚਰੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਨਿਤ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ॥
589.e: Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, forever and ever, make the Name of the Lord your daily occupation.

589.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ; ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਾ ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
589.e: If the Lord shows His Mercy, then I keep Him enshrined within my heart. ||1||

589.g: ਨਿਸਪਾਲਿਕ ਛੰਦ ॥
589.e: NISHPAALAK STANZA

589.g: ਆਨਿ ਸਰ ਤਾਨਿ ਅਰੁ ਮਾਨ ਕਰਿ ਛੋਰ ਹੀਂ ॥
ਐਨ ਸਰ ਚੈਨ ਕਰਿ ਤੈਨ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਰ ਹੀਂ ॥
589.e: By pulling their bows, the warriors are proudly discharging their arrows and are uniting arrows with arrows discharging swiftly the later arrows

589.g: ਘਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਚਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਆਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਲਾਗ ਹੀਂ ॥
ਛਾਡਿ ਰਣਿ ਖਾਇ ਬ੍ਰਿਣ ਬੀਰ ਬਰ ਭਾਗ ਹੀਂ ॥੩੮੦॥
589.e: They are striking blows with zeal and the great fighters also having been wounded are running away.380.

589.g: ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਰਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਧਿ ਅਰਿ ਧਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
ਜੋਧ ਬਰ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਧਰਿ ਬਿਰੋਧਿ ਸਰ ਲਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
589.e: The Lord (Kalki) is moving forward, killing the enemies angrily and consciously and is striking his arrows on the opponents

589.g: ਅੰਗ ਭਟ ਭੰਗ ਹੁਐ ਜੰਗ ਤਿਹ ਡਿਗਹੀਂ ॥
ਸੰਗਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਣ ਸ੍ਰੋਣ ਤਨ ਭਿਗਹੀਂ ॥੩੮੧॥
589.e: The warriors with chopped limbs are falling down in the battlefield and all their blood is oozing out from their bodies.381.

589.g: ਧਾਇ ਭਟਿ ਆਇ ਰਿਸ ਖਾਇ ਅਸਿ ਝਾਰਹੀਂ ॥
ਸੋਰ ਕਰਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਸਰ ਤੋਰ ਅਰਿ ਡਾਰਹੀਂ ॥
589.e: The warriors come in rage, strike the swords and are killing the enemies while shouting

589.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਜਿ ਪੈ ਨ ਭਜਿ ਭੂਮਿ ਰਨ ਸੋਭਹੀਂ ॥
ਪੇਖਿ ਛਬਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੁਤਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੁਰ ਲੋਭਹੀਂ ॥੩੮੨॥
589.e: They breath their last, but do not abandon the battlefield and seem splendid in this way, the women of gods are getting allured on seeing their beauty.382.

589.g: ਭਾਜ ਨਹ ਸਾਜਿ ਅਸਿ ਗਾਜਿ ਭਟ ਆਵਹੀਂ ॥
ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਕਰਿ ਬੋਧ ਹਰਿ ਜੋਧ ਅਸਿ ਲਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
589.e: The warriors are coming being bedecked with their swords and on this side the Lord in his fury is recognizing the real fighters

589.g: ਜੂਝਿ ਰਣਿ ਝਾਲਿ ਬ੍ਰਿਣ ਦੇਵ ਪੁਰਿ ਪਾਵਹੀਂ ॥
ਜੀਤਿ ਕੈ ਗੀਤ ਕੁਲਿ ਰੀਤ ਜਿਮ ਗਾਵਹੀਂ ॥੩੮੩॥
589.e: After fighting and getting wounded, the warriors leave for abode of gods and there they are welcomed with songs of victory.383.

589.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
589.e: Salok, Third Mehl:

589.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਰਜੀਵੜੇ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
589.e: They alone worship the Lord, who remain dead while yet alive; the Gurmukhs worship the Lord continually.

589.g: ਓਨਾ ਕਉ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਬਖਸਿਆ; ਮੇਟਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
589.e: The Lord blesses them with the treasure of devotional worship, which no one can destroy.

589.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਮਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਏਕੋ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
589.e: They obtain the treasure of virtue, the One True Lord, within their minds.

589.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੇ; ਫਿਰਿ ਵਿਛੋੜਾ. ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
589.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs remain united with the Lord; they shall never be separated again. ||1||

590.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
590.e: Pauree:

590.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਜਣ ਆਵਹਿ ॥
590.e: The minds of the Gursikhs are filled with the love of the Lord; they come and worship the Guru.

590.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਣੰਜਹਿ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ; ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਹਿ ॥
590.e: They trade lovingly in the Lord's Name, and depart after earning the profit of the Lord's Name.

590.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਵਹਿ ॥
590.e: The faces of the Gursikhs are radiant; in the Court of the Lord, they are approved.

590.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ. ਬੋਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਿਖ. ਗੁਣ ਸਾਂਝ ਕਰਾਵਹਿ ॥
590.e: The Guru, the True Guru, is the treasure of the Lord's Name; how very fortunate are the Sikhs who share in this treasure of virtue.

590.g: ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੰਉ. ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ; ਜੋ ਬਹਦਿਆ ਉਠਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ॥੧੧॥
590.e: I am a sacrifice to those Gursikhs who, sitting and standing, meditate on the Lord's Name. ||11||
Third Mehl:

590.g: ਕੰਚਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਿਰਮਲੀ; ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
590.e: That body is golden and immaculate, which is attached to the True Name of the True Lord.

590.g: ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
590.e: The Gurmukh obtains the Pure Light of the Luminous Lord, and his doubts and fears run away.

590.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
590.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs find lasting peace; night and day, they remain detached, while in the Love of the Lord. ||2||

590.g: ਤਾਜ ਕਹੂੰ ਗਜਰਾਜ ਰਣੰ; ਭਟ ਕੇਸਨ ਤੇ ਗਹਿ ਕੇਸਨ ਜੂਟੇ ॥
ਪਉਨ ਸਮਾਨ ਬਹੈ ਕਲਿ ਬਾਨ; ਸਬੈ ਅਰਿ ਬਾਦਲ ਸੇ ਚਲਿ ਫੂਟੇ ॥੩੮੮॥
590.e: Somewhere neighing and somewhere the elephant were seen running, the warriors catching the hair of one another were engaged in fight with them, the arrows were being discharged like the wind and with them, the arrows were being discharged like the wind an

590.g: ਧਾਇ ਪਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਬੜੇ ਭਟ; ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਸੰਭਾਰੇ ॥
ਪਟਿਸ ਲੋਹਹਥੀ ਪਰਸਾ ਕਰਿ; ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਚਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ ਚਉਕ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰੇ ॥
590.e: Holding their arrows, bows and swords the great warriors fell upon (the opponents), the warriors were striking blows from all the four directions, taking their swords, axes etc. in their hands

590.g: ਕੁੰਜਰ ਪੁੰਜ ਗਿਰੇ ਰਣਿ ਮੂਰਧਨ; ਸੋਭਤ ਹੈ ਅਤਿ ਡੀਲ ਡਿਲਾਰੇ ॥
ਰਾਵਣ ਰਾਮ ਸਮੈ ਰਣ ਕੇ; ਗਿਰਿਰਾਜ ਨੋ ਹਨਵੰਤਿ ਉਖਾਰੇ ॥੩੮੯॥
590.e: There were groups of elephants fallen in the war on the side and support of their faces and they appeared like the mountains uprooted and thrown by Hanuman in the Rama-Ravana war.389.

590.g: ਚਓਪੁ ਚਰੀ ਚਤੁਰੰਗ ਚਮੂੰ; ਕਰੁਣਾਲਯ ਕੇ ਪਰ ਸਿੰਧੁਰ ਪੇਲੇ ॥
ਧਾਇ ਪਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਹਠੀ; ਕਰ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਬੈ ਪਗ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਨ ਪਿਛੇਲੇ ॥
590.e: Taking the fourfold army, the Lord (Kalki) was attacked through elephants through the persistent warriors were chopped, but still they did not retrace their steps

590.g: ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨਨ ਕੇ ਘਨ ਸ︀ਯਾਮ ਘਨੇ ਤਨਿ ਆਯੁਧ ਝੇਲੇ ॥
ਸ੍ਰੋਨ ਰੰਗੇ ਰਮਣੀਅ ਰਮਾਪਤਿ; ਫਾਗੁਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਬਸੰਤ ਸੇ ਖੇਲੇ ॥੩੯੦॥
590.e: Enduring the blows of bows, swords and other weapons and dyed with blood, the Lord (Kalki) looked like one who had played Holi in the spring season.390.

590.g: ਘਾਇ ਸਬੈ ਸਹਿ ਕੈ ਕਮਲਾਪਤਿ ਕੋਪਿ ਭਰ︀ਯੋ ਕਰਿ ਆਯੁਧ ਲੀਨੇ ॥
ਦੁਜਨ ਸੈਨ ਬਿਖੈ ਧਸਿ ਕੈ; ਛਿਨ ਮੈ ਬਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਾਣ ਸਬੈ ਅਰਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
590.e: When wounded, the Lord was greatly enraged and he took his weapons in his hands, he penetrated into the army of the enemy and killed all of it in an instant

590.g: ਟੂਟ ਪਰੇ ਰਮਣੀ ਅਸ ਭੂਖਣ; ਬੀਰ ਬਲੀ ਅਤਿ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਚੀਨੇ ॥
ਯੌ ਉਪਮਾ ਉਪਜੀ ਮਨ ਮੈ; ਰਣ ਭੂਮਿ ਕੋ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਭੂਖਨ ਦੀਨੇ ॥੩੯੧॥
590.e: He fell upon the warriors and he seemed splendidly beautiful as if the had given the ornaments of wounds to all the warriors in the battlefield.391.

590.g: ਚਉਪਿ ਚੜਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਕਲੀ; ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਆਯੁਧ ਅੰਗ ਅਨੇਕਨ ਸਾਜੇ ॥
ਤਾਲ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ ਉਪੰਗ ਮੁਚੰਗ; ਸੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਭਲੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਾਜੇ ॥
590.e: The Lord Kalki, bedecked his limbs with weapons, and in great rage, went forward, many musical instruments including drums were played in the war-arena

590.g: ਪੂਰਿ ਫਟੀ ਛੁਟਿ ਧੂਰ ਜਟੀ; ਜਟ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਦੋਊ ਉਠਿ ਭਾਜੇ ॥
ਕੋਪ ਕਛੂ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਚਿਤ ਮੋ; ਕਲਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਜਬੈ ਰਣਿ ਗਾਜੇ ॥੩੯੨॥
590.e: Seeing that dreadful war, the matted locks of Shiva were also loosened and both the gods and demons fled away, all this happened at that time when Kalki thundered in rage in the battlefield.392.

590.g: ਬਾਜ ਹਨੇ ਗਜਰਾਜ ਹਨੇ; ਨ੍ਰਿਪਰਾਜ ਹਨੇ ਰਣ ਭੂਮਿ ਗਿਰਾਏ ॥
ਡੋਲਿ ਗਿਰਿਓ ਗਿਰ ਮੇਰ ਰਸਾਤਲ; ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਸਬੈ ਭਹਰਾਏ ॥
590.e: The horses, elephants, and kings were killed in the battlefield, the Sumeru mountain trembled and thrust into the earth, the gods and demons both became fearful

590.g: ਸਾਤੋਊ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਸੁਕੀ ਸਰਤਾ; ਸਬ ਲੋਕ ਅਲੋਕ ਸਬੈ ਥਹਰਾਏ ॥
ਚਉਕ ਚਕੇ ਦ੍ਰਿਗਪਾਲ ਸਬੈ; ਕਿਹ ਪੈ ਕਲਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ ਰਿਸਾਏ ॥੩੯੩॥
590.e: All the seven oceans and all the rivers dried up in fear all the people trembled, the guardians of all the directions were wonder-struck as to who had been attacked in anger by Kalki.393.

590.g: ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਸੰਭਾਰਿ ਹਠੀ; ਹਠ ਠਾਨਿ ਹਠੀ ਰਣਿ ਕੋਟਿਕੁ ਮਾਰੇ ॥
ਜਾਘ ਕਹੂੰ ਸਿਰ ਬਾਹ ਕਹੂੰ; ਅਸਿ ਰੇਣੁ ਪ੍ਰਮਾਣ ਸਬੈ ਕਰਿ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
590.e: Holding his bow and arrows, Kalki, killed crores of enemies, the legs, heads and swords lay scattered at several places, the Lord (Kalki) rolled all in the dust

590.g: ਬਾਜ ਕਹੂੰ ਗਜਰਾਜ ਧੁਜਾ; ਰਥ ਉਸਟ ਪਰੇ ਰਣਿ ਪੁਸਟ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
ਜਾਨੁਕ ਬਾਗ ਬਨਿਓ ਰਣਿ ਮੰਡਲ; ਪੇਖਨ ਕਉ ਜਟਿ ਧੂਰ ਪਧਾਰੇ ॥੩੯੪॥
590.e: The elephants, horses, chariots and camels were lying dead, it seemed that the battlefield had become and arrows and Shiva was looking for it, roaming hither and thither.394.

590.g: ਲਾਜ ਭਰੇ ਅਰਿਰਾਜ ਚਹੂੰ ਦਿਸ; ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲੇ, ਨਹੀ ਆਨਿ ਘਿਰੇ ॥
ਗਹਿ ਬਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਗਦਾ ਬਰਛੀ; ਛਟ ਛੈਲ ਛਕੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੌਪ ਚਿਰੇ ॥
590.e: The inimical kings, filled with shame ran in all the four directions and they again began to strike blows taking up their swords, maces, lances etc. with double zeal

590.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਮਾਨ ਸੁਜਾਨ ਅਜਾਨੁ ਭੁਜਾ; ਕਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਪਰੇ ਨਹੀ ਫੇਰਿ ਫਿਰੇ ॥
ਰਣ ਮੋ ਮਰਿ ਕੈ, ਜਸ ਕੋ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ; ਹਰਿ ਸੋ ਲਰਿ ਕੈ, ਭਵ ਸਿੰਧੁ ਤਰੇ ॥੩੯੫॥
590.e: He, whosoever came to fight with that most powerful Lord, did not return alive, he died while fighting with the Lord (Kalki) and earning approbation, ferried across the Ocean of fear.395.

590.g: ਰੰਗ ਸੋ ਜਾਨੁ ਸੁਰੰਗੇ ਹੈ ਸਿੰਧੁਰ; ਛੂਟੀ ਹੈ ਸੀਸ ਪੈ ਸ੍ਰੋਨ ਅਲੇਲੈ ॥
ਬਾਜ ਗਿਰੇ ਭਟ ਰਾਜ ਕਹੂੰ; ਬਿਚਲੇ ਕੁਪ ਕੈ ਕਲ ਕੇ ਅਸਿ ਕੇਲੈ ॥
590.e: With the currents of blood, having fallen on them, the elephants are seen dyed in beautiful colour, the Lord Kalki, in his fury, wrought such a havoc that somewhere the horses have fallen down and somewhere the superb warriors have been knocked down

590.g: ਚਾਚਰ ਜਾਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਪਰ; ਜੂਝਿ ਗਿਰੇ ਪਗ ਦ੍ਵੈ ਨ ਪਛੇਲੈ ॥
ਜਾਨੁਕ ਪਾਨ ਕੈ ਭੰਗ ਮਲੰਗ ਸੁ; ਫਾਗੁਨ ਅੰਤਿ ਬਸੰਤ ਸੋ ਖੇਲੈ ॥੩੯੬॥
590.e: Though the warriors are definitely falling on the earth, but they are not retracing even two steps backwards, they all seen like the wrestlers playing Holi after drinking hemp.396.

590.g: ਜੇਤਕ ਜੀਤਿ ਬਚੇ ਸੁ ਸਬੈ ਭਟ; ਚਓਪ ਚੜੇ ਚਹੁੰ ਓਰਨ ਧਾਏ ॥
ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਗਦਾ ਬਰਛੀ; ਅਸਿ ਕਾਢਿ ਲਏ ਕਰ ਮੋ ਚਮਕਾਏ ॥
590.e: The warriors who warriors who survived, they attacked from all the four sides with greater zeal, taking their bows, arrows, maces, lances and swords in their hands, they glistened them

590.g: ਚਾਬੁਕ ਮਾਰਿ ਤੁਰੰਗ ਧਸੇ ਰਨਿ; ਸਾਵਨ ਕੀ ਘਟਿ ਜਿਉ ਘਹਰਾਏ ॥
ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਲਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਲੈ ਕਰਵਾਰਿ ਸੁ; ਏਕ ਹਨੇ ਅਰਿ ਅਨੇਕ ਪਰਾਏ ॥੩੯੭॥
590.e: Whipping their horses and waving like the clouds of Sawan, they penetrated into the enemy’s army, but taking his sword in his hand, the Lord (Kalki) killed many and many and many fled away.397.

590.g: ਮਾਰ ਮਚੀ ਬਿਸੰਭਾਰ ਜਬੈ; ਤਬ ਆਯੁਧ ਛੋਰਿ ਸਬੈ ਭਟ ਭਾਜੇ ॥
ਡਾਰਿ ਹਥ︀ਯਾਰ ਉਤਾਰਿ ਸਨਾਹਿ ਸੁ ਏਕ ਹੀ ਬਾਰ ਭਜੇ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਜੇ ॥
590.e: When the dreadful war was waged in this way, the warriors fled away, leaving behind their weapons, they put off their armours and throwing their weapons fled and then they did not shout

590.g: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਲਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਤਹਾ; ਗਹਿ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਬੈ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਬਿਰਾਜੇ ॥
ਭੂਮਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਰ ਚਕਿਓ; ਛਬਿ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਦੋਊ ਲਖਿ ਲਾਜੇ ॥੩੯੮॥
590.e: Kalki, catching his weapons in the battlefield looks so charming that seeing his beauty, the earth, sky and nether-world were all feeling shy.398.

590.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਭਜੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਨਾ ਅਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਲਕੀ ਅਵਤਾਰ ਹਥ︀ਯਾਰ ਸੰਭਾਰੇ ॥
ਬਾਨ ਕਮਾਨ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਨ ਗਦਾ; ਛਿਨ ਬੀਚ ਸਬੈ ਕਰਿ ਚੂਰਨ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
590.e: Seeing the army of the enemy running away, Kalki holding his weapons his bow and arrows, his sword, his mace etc., mashed everyone in an instant

590.g: ਭਾਗਿ ਚਲੇ ਇਹ ਭਾਤਿ ਭਟਾ; ਜਿਮਿ ਪਉਨ ਬਹੇ ਦ੍ਰੁਮ ਪਾਤ ਨਿਹਾਰੇ ॥
ਪੈਨ ਪਰੀ ਕਛੁ ਮਾਨ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਹਿ; ਬਾਨਨ ਡਾਰਿ ਨਿਦਾਨ ਪਧਾਰੇ ॥੩੯੯॥
590.e: The warriors ran away like the leaves before the blow of wind, those who took shelter, survived, the others, discharging their arrows fled away.399.

590.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
590.e: Salok, Third Mehl:

590.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
590.e: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the treasure, which the Gurmukhs obtain.

590.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਘਰਿ ਹੋਦੀ ਵਥੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ; ਅੰਧੇ ਭਉਕਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਲਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
590.e: The self-willed manmukhs are blind; they do not realize that it is within their own home. They die barking and crying. ||1||

590.g: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
590.e: First Mehl:

590.g: ਜਾਲਉ ਐਸੀ ਰੀਤਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਮੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਵੀਸਰੈ ॥
590.e: Burn away those rituals which lead you to forget the Beloved Lord.

590.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਈ ਭਲੀ ਪਰੀਤਿ; ਜਿਤੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸੇਤੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
590.e: O Nanak, sublime is that love, which preserves my honor with my Lord Master. ||2||
Third Mehl:

590.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸਿਖਿਐ. ਸਾਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ; ਜਿਚਰੁ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦਿ, ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
590.e: Hearing the teachings, he does not appreciate them, as long as he is not Gurmukh, attached to the Word of the Shabad.

590.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
590.e: Serving the True Guru, the Naam comes to abide in the mind, and doubts and fears run away.

590.g: ਜੇਹਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨੋ ਜਾਣੈ. ਤੇਹੋ ਹੋਵੈ; ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
590.e: As he knows the True Guru, so he is transformed, and then, he lovingly focuses his consciousness on the Naam.

590.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਆਗੈ ॥੨॥
590.e: O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained; he shall be resplendent in the Court of the Lord hereafter. ||2||

590.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
590.e: Salok, Third Mehl:

590.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੰਉ. ਆਪਿ ਤੁਠਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ; ਆਪੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਜਨ ਲਾਇ ॥
590.e: He Himself is pleased with His humble devotees; my Beloved Lord attaches them to Himself.

590.g: ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਦਿਤੀਅਨੁ; ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਹਰਿ ਬਣਾਇ ॥
590.e: The Lord blesses His humble devotees with royalty; He fashions the true crown upon their heads.

590.g: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਨਿਰਮਲੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
590.e: They are always at peace, and immaculately pure; they perform service for the True Guru.

590.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਓਇ. ਨ ਆਖੀਅਹਿ; ਭਿੜਿ ਮਰਹਿ. ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
590.e: They are not said to be kings, who die in conflict, and then enter again the cycle of reincarnation.

590.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਨਕਂ‍ੀ ਵਢਂ‍ੀ ਫਿਰਹਿ; ਸੋਭਾ. ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
590.e: O Nanak, without the Name of the Lord, they wander about with their noses cut off in disgrace; they get no respect at all. ||1||

590.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
590.e: Pauree:

590.g: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
590.e: Serve the One Lord, the Great Giver; meditate on the One Lord.

590.g: ਹਰਿ ਇਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
590.e: Beg from the One Lord, the Great Giver, and you shall obtain your heart's desires.

590.g: ਜੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਤਾ ਲਾਜ ਮਰਾਈਐ ॥
590.e: But if you beg from another, then you shall be shamed and destroyed.

590.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਈਐ ॥
590.e: One who serves the Lord obtains the fruits of his rewards; all of his hunger is satisfied.

590.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤਿਨ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ; ਜਿਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧੦॥
590.e: Nanak is a sacrifice to those, who night and day, meditate within their hearts on the Name of the Lord. ||10||

590.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
590.e: Pauree:

590.g: ਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਨੀ ॥
590.e: Blessed, blessed are those Gursikhs, who, with their ears, listen to the Guru's Teachings about the Lord.

590.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ; ਤਿਨਿ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਭੰਨੀ ॥
590.e: The Guru, the True Guru, implants the Naam within them, and their egotism and duality are silenced.

590.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ. ਕੋ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਡਿਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੰਨੀ ॥
590.e: There is no friend, other than the Name of the Lord; the Lord's humble servants reflect upon this and see.

590.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਨਿ; ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
590.e: O Nanak, without serving the True Guru, they are bound and beaten in the City of Death; they arise and depart with blackened faces. ||1||

590.g: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਿਆ ਛੰਦ ॥
590.e: SUPRIYA STANZA

590.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਭਟ ਮਿਲਤ, ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰ ਉਚਾਰਤ ॥

591.e: Third Mehl:

591.g: ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਹੋਰ ਸਗਲੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸਬਾਈ ॥
591.e: In this world, there is one Husband Lord; all other beings are His brides.

591.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
591.e: Salok, Third Mehl:

591.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵੇ. ਜਗਤੁ ਮੁਆ; ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
591.e: Without serving the True Guru, the people of the world are dead; they waste their lives away in vain.

591.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਅਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ; ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
591.e: In love with duality, they suffer terrible pain; they die, and are reincarnated, and continue coming and going.

591.g: ਵਿਸਟਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੂਨੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
591.e: They live in manure, and are reincarnated again and again.

591.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ; ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥੧॥
591.e: O Nanak, without the Name, the Messenger of Death punishes them; in the end, they depart regretting and repenting. ||1||

591.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
591.e: Pauree:

591.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦਿ; ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ. ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
591.e: As Gurmukh, Prahlaad meditated on the Lord, and was saved.

591.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਨਕਿ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥
591.e: As Gurmukh, Janak lovingly centered his consciousness on the Lord's Name.

591.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬਸਿਸਟਿ; ਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਾਈ ॥
591.e: As Gurmukh, Vashisht taught the Teachings of the Lord.

591.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ. ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ; ਨ ਕਿਨੈ ਪਾਇਆ. ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
591.e: Without the Guru, no one has found the Lord's Name, O my Siblings of Destiny.

591.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਲਹਾਈ ॥੧੩॥
591.e: The Lord blesses the Gurmukh with devotion. ||13||

591.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
591.e: Salok, Third Mehl:

591.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ. ਨ ਆਈਆ; ਸਬਦਿ. ਨ ਲਾਗੋ ਭਾਉ ॥
591.e: One who has no faith in the True Guru, and who does not love the Word of the Shabad,

591.g: ਓਸ ਨੋ ਸੁਖੁ. ਨ ਉਪਜੈ; ਭਾਵੈ. ਸਉ ਗੇੜਾ ਆਵਉ ਜਾਉ ॥
591.e: shall find no peace, even though he may come and go hundreds of times.

591.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲੈ; ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਉ ॥੧॥
591.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh meets the True Lord with natural ease; he is in love with the Lord. ||1||
Third Mehl:

591.g: ਏ ਮਨ. ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਲਹੁ; ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ. ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਦੁਖੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
591.e: O mind, search for such a True Guru, by serving whom the pains of birth and death are dispelled.

591.g: ਸਹਸਾ ਮੂਲਿ. ਨ ਹੋਵਈ; ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥
591.e: Doubt shall never afflict you, and your ego shall be burnt away through the Word of the Shabad.

591.g: ਕੂੜੈ ਕੀ ਪਾਲਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ; ਸਚੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
591.e: The veil of falsehood shall be torn down from within you, and Truth shall come to dwell in the mind.

591.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ. ਮਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ; ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
591.e: Peace and happiness shall fill your mind deep within, if you act according to truth and self-discipline.

591.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
591.e: O Nanak, by perfect good karma, you shall meet the True Guru, and then the Dear Lord, by His Sweet Will, shall bless you with His Mercy. ||2||
Third Mehl:

591.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਣੇ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
591.e: The Gurmukhs always look beautiful in the Court of the Lord; they practice the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

591.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ; ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
591.e: There is a lasting peace and happiness deep within them; at the Court of the True Lord, they receive honor.

591.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
591.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are blessed with the Name of the Lord; they merge imperceptibly into the True Lord. ||2||

591.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
591.e: Pauree:

591.g: ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ. ਦੀਬਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਮੁਠੀ ਵਿਚਿ, ਜਗਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਆਇਆ ॥
591.e: The whole world comes under the control of one whose home is filled with the Lord, the King.

591.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਉ ਤਲਕੀ ਕਿਸੈ ਦੀ ਨਾਹੀ; ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨਿ. ਸਭਿ ਆਣਿ ਪੈਰੀ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
591.e: He is subject to no one else's rule, and the Lord, the King, causes everyone to fall at his feet.

591.g: ਮਾਣਸਾ ਕਿਅਹੁ ਦੀਬਾਣਹੁ. ਕੋਈ ਨਸਿ ਭਜਿ ਨਿਕਲੈ; ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਹੁ. ਕੋਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
591.e: One may run away from the courts of other men, but where can one go to escape the Lord's Kingdom?

591.g: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਬਾਨੁ. ਵਸਿਆ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ; ਤਿਨਿ ਰਹਦੇ ਖੁਹਦੇ ਆਣਿ, ਸਭਿ ਭਗਤਾ ਅਗੈ ਖਲਵਾਇਆ ॥
591.e: The Lord is such a King, who abides in the hearts of His devotees; He brings the others, and makes them stand before His devotees.

591.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ. ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨੈ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
591.e: The glorious greatness of the Lord's Name is obtained only by His Grace; how few are the Gurmukhs who meditate on Him. ||14||

591.g: ਬਿਸੇਖ ਛੰਦ ॥
591.e: VISHESH STANZA

591.g: ਭਾਜਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਭਟ ਲਾਜ; ਸਬੈ ਤਜਿ ਸਾਜ ਜਹਾ ॥
ਨਾਚਤ ਭੂਤ ਪਿਸਾਚ; ਨਿਸਾਚਰ ਰਾਜ ਤਹਾ ॥
591.e: Many warriors abandoning their shame, and leaving behind everything, are running away, and the ghosts, fiends and imps dancing in the battlefield, are ruling over it

591.g: ਦੇਖਤ ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ; ਮਹਾ ਰਣ ਕੋ ਬਰਨੈ ॥
ਜੂਝ ਭਯੋ ਜਿਹ ਭਾਤਿ; ਸੁ ਪਾਰਥ ਸੋ ਕਰਨੈ ॥੪੦੪॥
591.e: The gods and demons all are saying this that this war is dreadful like the war of Arjuna and Karan.404.

591.g: ਦਾਵ ਕਰੈ ਰਿਸ ਖਾਇ; ਮਹਾ ਹਠ ਠਾਨ ਹਠੀ ॥
ਕੋਪ ਭਰੇ ਇਹ ਭਾਤ; ਸੁ ਪਾਵਕ ਜਾਨੁ ਭਠੀ ॥
591.e: The persistent warriors, in their fury, are striking blows and they appear like the furnaces of fire

591.g: ਕ੍ਰੁਧ ਭਰੇ ਰਣਿ ਛਤ੍ਰਜ; ਅਤ੍ਰਣ ਝਾਰਤ ਹੈ ॥
ਭਾਜਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਹੀ; ਪਾਵ ਸੁ ਮਾਰਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੫॥
591.e: The kings in their ire are striking their weapons and arms, and instead of running away, they are shouting “Kill, Kill”.405.

591.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕਉ. ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਨੀ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਗਲ ਮੰਨੀ ॥
591.e: Those Gursikhs, with whom the Lord is pleased, accept the Word of the True Guru.

591.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ; ਤਿਨੀ ਚੜੀ. ਚਵਗਣਿ ਵੰਨੀ ॥੧੨॥
591.e: Those Gurmukhs who meditate on the Naam are imbued with the four-fold color of the Lord's Love. ||12||

591.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਭਟ ਭਾਜਿ, ਪੁਕਾਰਤ ਆਰਤ ॥
591.e: Somewhere the warriors, gathering together, are shouting “kill, kill” and somewhere, getting agitated, they ae lamenting

591.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਜੋਧ ਫਿਰਤ ਦਲ ਗਾਹਤ ॥
ਕੇਤਕ ਜੂਝ ਬਰੰਗਨ ਬ੍ਰਯਾਹਤ ॥੪੦੦॥
591.e: Many warriors are moving within their army and many after embracing martyrdom are wedding the heavenly damsels.400.

591.g: ਕਹੂੰ ਬਰ ਬੀਰ ਫਿਰਤ ਸਰ ਮਾਰਤ ॥
ਕਹੂੰ ਰਣ ਛੋਡਿ ਭਜਤ ਭਟ ਆਰਤ ॥
591.e: Somewhere the warriors, discharging their arrows, are roaming and somewhere the afflicted warriors, leaving the battlefield, are running away

591.g: ਕੇਈ ਡਰੁ ਡਾਰਿ ਹਨਤ ਰਣਿ ਜੋਧਾ ॥
ਕੇਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰ ਰਟਤ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਾ ॥੪੦੧॥
591.e: Many are destroying the warriors fearlessly and many in their rage are shouting repeatedly “kill, kill”.401.

591.g: ਕੇਈ ਖਗ ਖੰਡਿ ਗਿਰਤ ਰਣਿ ਛਤ੍ਰੀ ॥
ਕੇਤਕ ਭਾਗਿ ਚਲਤ ਤ੍ਰਸਿ ਅਤ੍ਰੀ ॥
591.e: The daggers of many are falling having been shattered into bits and many wielders of arms and weapons are running away in fear

591.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਨਿਭ੍ਰਮ ਜੁਧ ਮਚਾਵਤ ॥
ਆਹਵ ਸੀਝਿ ਦਿਵਾਲਯ ਪਾਵਤ ॥੪੦੨॥
591.e: Many are roaming and fighting and embracing martyrdom are leaving for heaven.402.

591.g: ਕੇਤਕ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਰਤ ਰਣ ਮੰਡਲਿ ॥
ਕੇਈਕੁ ਭੇਦਿ ਚਲੇ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡਲ ॥
591.e: Many are dying while fighting in the battlefield and many after going through the universe are getting separated from it

591.g: ਕੇਈਕੁ ਆਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਹਾਰਤ ਸਾਗੈ ॥
ਕੇਤਕ ਭੰਗ ਗਿਰਤ ਹੁਇ ਆਂਗੈ ॥੪੦੩॥
591.e: Many are striking blows with their lances and the limbs of many, being chopped, are falling down.403.

591.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
591.e: Salok, Third Mehl:

591.g: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਇਰੁ ਕਰੂਪੁ ਹੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਨਕੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
591.e: The self-willed manmukh is cowardly and ugly; lacking the Name of the Lord, his nose is cut off in disgrace.

591.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਵਿਆਪਿਆ; ਸੁਪਨੈ ਭੀ ਸੁਖੁ. ਨਾਹਿ ॥
591.e: Night and day, he is engrossed in worldly affairs, and even in his dreams, he finds no peace.

591.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਉਬਰਹਿ; ਨਾਹਿ ਤ. ਬਧੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਹਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
591.e: O Nanak, if he becomes Gurmukh, then he shall be saved; otherwise, he is held in bondage, and suffers in pain. ||1||

592.g: ਸਭਿ ਘਟ ਭੋਗਵੈ. ਅਲਿਪਤੁ ਰਹੈ; ਅਲਖੁ. ਨ ਲਖਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
592.e: He enjoys the hearts of all, and yet He remains detached; He is unseen; He cannot be described.

592.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ; ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
592.e: The Perfect Guru reveals Him, and through the Word of His Shabad, we come to understand Him.

592.g: ਪੁਰਖੈ ਸੇਵਹਿ. ਸੇ ਪੁਰਖ ਹੋਵਹਿ; ਜਿਨੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਈ ॥
592.e: Those who serve their Husband Lord, become like Him; their egos are burnt away by His Shabad.

592.g: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸਰੀਕੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਵੈਰਾਈ ॥
592.e: He has no rival, no attacker, no enemy.

592.g: ਨਿਹਚਲ ਰਾਜੁ ਹੈ ਸਦਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੇਰਾ; ਨਾ ਆਵੈ. ਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
592.e: His rule is unchanging and eternal; He does not come or go.

592.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈ ॥
592.e: Night and day, His servant serves Him, singing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

592.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਵੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਚੇ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
592.e: Beholding the Glorious Greatness of the True Lord, Nanak blossoms forth. ||2||

592.g: ਚੰਚਲਾ ਛੰਦ ॥
592.e: CHANCHALA STANZA

592.g: ਮਾਰਬੇ ਕੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਤਾਕਿ; ਧਾਏ ਬੀਰ ਸਾਵਧਾਨ ॥
ਹੋਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਜੁਧ ਕੇ; ਜਹਾ ਤਹਾ ਸਬੈ ਬਿਧਾਨ ॥
592.e: In order to kill Kalki, the warriors cautiously marched forward and began to wage war here, there and everywhere

592.g: ਭੀਮ ਭਾਤਿ ਧਾਇ ਕੈ; ਨਿਸੰਕ ਘਾਇ ਕਰਤ ਆਇ ॥
ਜੂਝਿ ਜੂਝ ਕੈ ਮਰੈ; ਸੁ ਦੇਵ ਲੋਕਿ ਬਸਤ ਜਾਇ ॥੪੦੮॥
592.e: The brave warriors like Bhima are fearlessly striking blows and after fighting and embracing martyrdom, they are getting abode in the region of gods.408.

592.g: ਤਾਨਿ ਤਾਨਿ ਬਾਨ ਕੋ; ਅਜਾਨੁ ਬਾਹ ਧਾਵਹੀ ॥
ਜੂਝਿ ਜੂਝ ਕੈ ਮਰੈ; ਅਲੋਕ ਲੋਕ ਪਾਵਹੀ ॥
592.e: Pulling their bows and discharging arrows, they are advancing towards the Lord (Kalki) and embracing martyrdom, they are going to the next world

592.g: ਰੰਗ ਜੰਗਿ ਅੰਗ ਨੰਗ; ਭੰਗ ਅੰਗਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਤ ॥
ਟੂਕਿ ਟੂਕਿ ਹੋਇ ਗਿਰੈ; ਸੁ ਦੇਵ ਸੁੰਦ੍ਰੀਨਿ ਬਰਤ ॥੪੦੯॥
592.e: They are absorbed in fighting and are falling into bits before him, these warriors are falling into bits for the sake of heavenly damsels and are embracing death.409.
Third Mehl:

592.g: ਇਕੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਗਤਾ; ਹੋਰੁ ਜਗੁ ਸੂਤਾ. ਮੋਹਿ ਪਿਆਸਿ ॥
592.e: Only the Guru is awake; the rest of the world is asleep in emotional attachment and desire.

592.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ. ਜਾਗੰਨਿ ਸੇ; ਜੋ ਰਤੇ. ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਗੁਣਤਾਸਿ ॥
592.e: Those who serve the True Guru and remain wakeful, are imbued with the True Name, the treasure of virtue.

592.g: ਦੇਖਤ ਹੈ ਦਿਵ ਦੇਵ; ਧਨੈ ਧਨਿ ਜੰਪਤ ਹੈ ॥
ਭੂਮ ਅਕਾਸ ਪਤਾਲ; ਚਵੋ ਚਕ ਕੰਪਤ ਹੈ ॥
592.e: The gods and demons both are saying, Bravo!" Looking at the fighting, the earth, sky, neither-world and all the four direcitions trembling

592.g: ਭਾਜਤ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਬੀਰ; ਮਹਾ ਰਣਿ ਗਾਜਤ ਹੈ ॥
ਜਛ ਭੁਜੰਗਨ ਨਾਰਿ; ਲਖੇ ਛਬਿ ਲਾਜਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੬॥
592.e: The warriors are not running away, but are thundering in the war-arena, seeing the glory of those warriors the women of Yakshas and Nagas are getting shy.406.

592.g: ਧਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਕਰਿ ਕੋਪ; ਮਹਾ ਸੁਰ ਸੂਰ ਤਹਾ ॥
ਮਾਡਤ ਹੈ ਬਿਕਰਾਰ; ਭਯੰਕਰ ਜੁਧ ਜਹਾ ॥
592.e: The great warriors, getting enraged, have attacked and are waging a dreadful and frightening war

592.g: ਪਾਵਤ ਹੈ ਸੁਰ ਨਾਰਿ; ਸੁ ਸਾਮੁਹਿ ਜੁਝਤ ਹੈ ॥
ਦੇਵ ਅਦੇਵ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ; ਸਬੈ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਸੁਝਤ ਹੈ ॥੪੦੭॥
592.e: Embracing martyrdom in the ear, they are meeting the heavenly damsels and this war appears as a great war to all the gods, demons and Yakshas.407.
Third Mehl:

592.g: ਹੰਉਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਖੜਕੁ ਹੈ; ਖੜਕੇ ਖੜਕਿ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
592.e: In egotism, one is assailed by fear; he passes his life totally troubled by fear.

592.g: ਹੰਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਹੈ; ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
592.e: Egotism is such a terrible disease; he dies, to be reincarnated - he continues coming and going.

592.g: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਤਿਨਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
592.e: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny meet with the True Guru, God Incarnate.

592.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਉਬਰੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
592.e: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, they are redeemed; their egos are burnt away through the Word of the Shabad. ||2||

592.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
592.e: Salok, Third Mehl:

592.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵ. ਨ ਕੀਨੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ. ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
592.e: One who does not serve the Guru as Gurmukh, who does not love the Lord's Name,

592.g: ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ. ਨ ਆਇਓ; ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
592.e: and who does not savor the taste of the Shabad, shall die, and be reborn, over and over again.

592.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਧੁ. ਨ ਚੇਤਈ; ਕਿਤੁ ਆਇਆ ਸੈਸਾਰਿ ॥
592.e: The blind, self-willed manmukh does not think of the Lord; why did he even come into the world?

592.g: ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਲੰਘੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
592.e: O Nanak, that Gurmukh, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, crosses over the world-ocean. ||1||

592.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
592.e: Salok, Third Mehl:

592.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੰਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
592.e: Those who meet the True Guru, ever sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises.

592.g: ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ; ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
